About us

Greyamp is a boutique Management Consulting firm that works with large enterprises to help them on their Digital Transformation journeys, going across the organisation, covering process, people, culture, and technology. The team consists of multi-potential individuals who enable organisations to become more networked, collaborative, innovative while implementing agile ways of working. Greyamp started in 2015 with this focus and till now has worked with and digitally-enabled organisations in South-East Asia. Greyamp currently has an in-house SaaS based digital product called GALE to enable organisations build future ready talent. At Greyamp, we're inviting you to join our team and explore our unique culture. If you're looking for a workplace that values curiosity, encourages ownership, and embraces empathy, Greyamp is the place for you. Here you will collaborate with top talent, develop your skills through various opportunities, and make a meaningful impact for our clients.

🚀 We’re Hiring | Senior AI Engineer 
Are you an engineer who builds AI-powered applications, not just uses AI tools?

Greyamp Consulting is looking for a Senior AI Engineer (6–8 years) to build production-grade AI solutions for enterprise clients.
What we’re looking for:
- Strong backend engineering in Python and Python web framework like FastAPI for building APIs and backend services
- Hands-on experience with RAG & Agentic AI frameworks like Langchain, Langgraph, DeepAgents for building LLM-powered GenAI and Agentic AI applications. 
- Strong coding, debugging and problem-solving skills
- Ability to build independently and understand your own code/design decisions

📍 Bangalore | Travel across India & Southeast Asia | Full-time | Client-facing

If you're passionate about building real-world AI solutions and solving complex business problems, we'd love to hear from you.

Interested? Send us your profile at talent@greyamp.com

#Hiring #AIEngineer #GenerativeAI #AgenticAI #Python #AIFullstack #BangaloreJobs #TechHiring

✨ Highlights from a Day That Redefined AI, Talent & GCCs

What an incredible day at the AI World Talent, Tech & GCC Summit 2026 at IIT Alumni Centre, Bengaluru! 

From powerful keynotes to thought-provoking panel discussions and high-impact networking, the summit brought together some of the brightest minds shaping the future of AI, Talent, and Global Capability Centers (GCCs).

Here’s what made the day unforgettable:

 • Real conversations on scaling AI from pilots to enterprise-wide impact
 • India’s talent ecosystem taking center stage in global innovation
 • GCCs evolving into AI-first, strategic growth engines
 • Meaningful connections between leaders, innovators, and future builders

The energy, the ideas, and the collaboration, everything reflected one thing clearly: The future is AI-first, and it’s being built right here.

Where business agility meets innovation, transformation becomes truly human!

We’re proud to welcome Greyamp Consulting as the Associate Partner for the Talent Tech & GCC Summit 2026, happening on March 29 at the IIT Alumni Centre, Bengaluru.

For over a decade, Greyamp has worked at the intersection of strategy and execution - helping enterprises not just transform, but build the systems that make transformation sustainable. Their work goes beyond digital and agile adoption to designing how organizations actually operate in an AI-driven world.

At the core of Greyamp’s approach is a clear belief: transformation only works when accountability is built into the system. With deep expertise across people, process, culture, and technology, Greyamp is helping organizations build future-ready talent ecosystems and drive measurable, lasting impact.

As enterprises move toward AI-native, agile, and human-centric operating models, Greyamp Consulting stands at the forefront - designing the operating rules that make transformation real, responsible, and scalable.
